summary: Rush into epic tower-defense battles: lead a strategy & defend the elven kingdom
description:
Welcome to Kingdom Rush Origins, the exciting offline tower defense strategy game. Here you can unleash epic td battles for the kingdom, with the power of the elf. Use brand new towers and heroes! As the third installment of the Kingdom Rush epic offline strategy saga, this prequel has earned td accolades from critics for its lightning-fast, exceptionally captivating td battles. They make this offline game a hit between kingdom td strategy and tower defense games lovers. If you like tactical defense challenges, and an epic offline strategy game - try this tower defense and fall in love with Kingdom Rush’s tower strategy games! In this prequel, command the elven army to defend the battlefield in a mystical realm. Plan your defense against sea serpents, evil sorcerers, and wave after wave of enemies. Upgrade brand-spankin' new towers & heroes. Use spells, beat challenge and set a defense in epic td battles and boss fights to advance in an epic offline adventure! Kingdom Rush Origins packs in a treasure trove of new td content and strategy game features while keeping the signature look that millions of strategy game players love. Rush to the epic games of Kingdom Rush and explore mysterious elven forests, magical faery realms, and even floating ruins in this fantastic tower defense!

Build powerful towers on the battlefield

 ★ Unleash the power of the elf realm with brand-new towers and heroes! Elf Archers, Mystic Mages, and the Elven Infantry - seize each tower in your army to help in challenges and td battles. ★ Discover 8 new specialized tower upgrades with over 18 battlefield abilities! Clash your enemies in mystic td battles with elven marksmen, runed bears, magic-wielding wizards, and giant animated trees. Execute your strategy with the unique tower abilities and the extraordinary power of each tower!

Train mighty, legendary heroes in epic td battles!

 ★ Master and upgrade 16 legendary heroes, their powers and spells in an epic td prequel! ★ Rain lightning, summon reinforcements - use each hero’s unique power to clash with your enemies in a legendary defense game campaign!

Fight and clash hordes of new Kingdom Rush styled enemies in epic tower defense battles, challenges and boss fights!

 ★ Command the battlefield against 30 new enemy types and engage in epic td battles! Face hordes of Gnolls, giant spiders, and the terrible Twilight army. Set up your tower strategy and defend the realm! ★ Plan your strategy to deal with intense td boss fights like a good old offline strategy game should have!

More fantastic epic games & defense game content!

 ★ Countless hours of epic games & offline battles with over 70 achievements, with three difficulty modes for rising heroes and veterans alike. Explore the elf realm and own the battlefield! ★ Play different offline game modes with a different tower strategy - Classic, Iron, and Heroic - and prove yourself in action-packed challenges. ★ Get new-and-improved tower defense tactical equipment using your hard-earned gems in the Gnome shop. ★ Study your enemies, towers and defense strategy with an in-game encyclopedia. ★ No internet? Play epic games offline anyways! Play this prequel tower defense game, even offline! —------------------------------ Praise for Kingdom Rush series: Google’s Editor’s Choice Award, IGN Editor's Choice, Slide To Play Must Have, GameInformer Gold Award, 148 Apps Editor's Choice, Jay is Games Game of the Year, Pocket Gamer Gold Award, CNET Editor’s Choice Award, Gamezebo 4.5/5, Touch Arcade 4.5/5,.
